summary: Iteration-2 E2E testing of GezGelir. Backend: 39/39 pytest tests PASSED against public URL — covering JWT register/login/me, duplicate-email 400, short-password 422, wrong-password 401, brute-force 429 lockout (best-effort retry due to ingress race), 401 gating on ALL data endpoints (driver/me, trips, trips/{id}, earnings/summary, earnings/series, wallet, wallet/transactions, bank-accounts, gamification, POST withdraw/drive/stop/bank), per-user data isolation (A cannot see or fetch B's trips), demo login mapping to Ömer, config public with multiplier+missions+badges, trips include points+route_label, drive/stop returns points, gamification shape (level/next/progress, multiplier, 3 missions with progress+completed, 6 badges with earned booleans, first_drive earned for demo), bank-accounts CRUD (list, add non-default, set-default, edit, delete-default reassigns, first-account auto-default), withdraw amount>available -> 400, invalid bank_account_id -> 400, valid withdraw creates -amount tx with status 'Beklemede' and debits available_balance, transaction appears in list with Beklemede/İşleniyor, drive/stop creates trip with eligible≈0.97*km and points array. Frontend (390x844 mobile): fresh register -> onboarding -> Home with multiplier-banner OK, Sürüşler shows 11 trip-items and opening trip-detail-sheet renders route-map with a leaflet-container and 3 polylines (green route drawn), Kazanç shows 3 mission-items and 6 badge-* items, Cüzdan bank-sheet CRUD works end to end (add UI Bank -> 2 items, set-default, delete -> 1 item), withdraw-button opens withdraw-sheet with 1 account-option, ₺20 confirm -> withdraw-success -> new tx appears (7 total), Profil signout returns to auth-screen, Demo login button prefills demo@gezgelir.com/demo1234 and lands the demo user in.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout (429 after 5 wrong attempts) is intermittent under the K8s ingress. Cause: identifier is `ip:email` and request.client.host resolves to different upstream IPs across requests (ingress may forward from multiple hops or use pooled proxies). Consider using X-Forwarded-For (leftmost trusted value) or just the email as the identifier so lockout is deterministic. Repro: 20 consecutive wrong logins for a fresh user yield 401s with only occasional 429s.

ui_bugs.issue: The top-right 'Atla' (skip) button ([data-testid=onboarding-skip]) is pointer-intercepted by its sibling `<div class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 -mt-6">`. The `-mt-6` (negative margin) causes the content column to stretch upward over the header row and captures taps. Real users tapping 'Atla' may not always dismiss onboarding. Suggested fix: give the header row `relative z-10` (or `pointer-events-auto` while removing pointer events from the middle overlay), or drop the `-mt-6`.

action_items: Fix onboarding-skip pointer-interception (remove -mt-6 or bump header z-index / pointer-events).
Make login lockout identifier deterministic (email-only or X-Forwarded-For) — current ingress-based ip:email allows attackers to bypass by rotating hop IPs.
Optional hardening (from iteration 1): make withdraw balance decrement conditional ($inc with balance>=amount filter) to prevent concurrent-overdraw race.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py withdraw endpoint uses non-atomic read-then-update on driver balance; two concurrent withdraw requests could race and overdraw. Prefer a conditional update: db.drivers.update_one({id, available_balance: {$gte: amount}}, {$inc: {available_balance: -amount, withdrawn_this_month: amount}}) and check modified_count before inserting the tx.

check_lockout() uses request.client.host which is the immediate socket peer (ingress proxy) — this can rotate and defeats the lockout. Trust X-Forwarded-For (with a configured proxy list) or lock by email only.
Onboarding.jsx layout: nested flex-1 + negative margin creates an overlay that swallows header button taps.
seed_data_creation: Tests register several TEST_* users (each auto-seeded with 14 trips, 6 tx, 1 bank account by the backend), added and deleted UI Bank on a fresh user, executed one ₺10 and one ₺20 demo withdrawal. Demo driver Ömer's balances drift downward with each run — acceptable for a demo dataset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (39 pytest cases across TestAuth, TestScoping, TestBasics, TestTrips, TestEarnings, TestGamification, TestBankAccounts, TestWithdraw, TestDriveStop). New test emails must use domains accepted by pydantic EmailStr with deliverability check (e.g. @example.com — .test/.local are rejected). Withdrawal status is time-computed: <20s Beklemede, <75s İşleniyor, else Tamamlandı — a freshly-created withdraw reads 'Beklemede'. Lockout test uses up to 20 retries because of the ingress identifier race noted above. Onboarding-skip is currently obstructed; dismiss via clicking [data-testid=onboarding-next] three times instead.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Onboarding-skip obstruction: sibling div `.flex-1 ... -mt-6` visually overlaps the header row containing the skip button and captures pointer events. 2) Lockout flakiness: identifier = `ip:email` where ip = request.client.host, which behind the K8s ingress can be any of several proxy pods, so counters are split across identifiers and rarely reach 5 for the same key.
